purpose: Everything that must not change after the FTN sample is opened, hashed before it was opened. A control model edited after seeing the vendor sample is not a control.

authorization.basis: OWNER DIRECTION, 2026-09-08: 'Use the FTN sample first to answer the only question that matters: does this data materially improve our model?'
authorization.what_the_contract_says: ROUTE-BB1 s7 found the supplied PDF grants no written permitted use: it is an unsigned draft, s6.1 licenses only a Client under an executed agreement, s5.2 restricts data to Client property, and no evaluation/trial/sample clause exists.
authorization.resolution: The sample was supplied to the owner by FTN and the owner is the counterparty to that relationship. Evaluating a vendor sample to decide whether to buy is the owner's commercial judgement, not a technical one, and the owner has given it explicitly. That finding is recorded rather than re-argued, so the basis for proceeding is visible in the record.
unchanged_by_this: no FTN system accessed or scraped

frozen_necessity_curve.source: ROUTE-BB1 s5, computed and committed BEFORE the sample was opened
frozen_necessity_curve.rule: rho_FTN is mapped ONTO this curve. The curve is not recomputed, refitted or adjusted after observing FTN.

rules_for_this_packet: no parameter is trained, fitted or tuned on the FTN game
the control architecture is not modified after unsealing
no threshold or metric is chosen after seeing FTN results
one game is diagnostic, never confirmatory
findings are classified OBSERVED_IN_THIS_SAMPLE / PLAUSIBLE_LEAGUE_VALUE / UNPROVEN_WITH_ONE_GAME
